request: Fix the agent's code tools. callers (repo_map): for a qualified query ("Parser::parse_input", "Parser > parse_input", "Parser.parse_input") list under "Declared in:" only declarations matching the qualifier, and say the others as "also declared in N other file(s)" rather than as declarations "not shown"; unqualified queries list all. Tool errors that already start with "Error:" (neighbours, callers) are not prefixed again, e.g. "Error: no declaration named ..."; a missing path reads exactly 'Error: "path" is required.'. diagnostics for a reported file with no problems says it "parses clean"/"no problems"; outline stops at its size cap; cut long diagnostic messages on a char boundary.
